function.description: Execute a REAL cross-chain bridge (spends funds, signs + broadcasts on the source chain). Auto-routes by chain: Khalani between its supported chains; Relay to/from Robinhood Chain (which Khalani does NOT cover). REQUIRES a fresh matching bridge_quote FIRST on the SAME provider — the execute gate blocks a bridge with no fresh matching quote, so always preview with bridge_quote before calling this. Resolve fromToken/toToken addresses via token_find first. `amountRaw` is in RAW base units (wei/lamports), matching the bridge quote.
function.name: bridge

amountRaw.description: Amount in raw atomic units of fromToken (e.g. USDC has 6 decimals, so 1 USDC = "1000000"). Get the token's decimals from token_find / khalani.tokens.search, which returns decimals per chain — a raw amount next to a token whose decimals you have not read is a thousandfold error waiting to happen.

filler.description: Restrict quotes to a specific filler.

recipient.description: Destination recipient override (defaults to your dest-chain wallet).
